h: How AI security failures are endangering your supply chain – and what you can do
s: Black Kite research finds widespread cybersecurity weaknesses across AI suppliers, exposing enterprise networks to critical vulnerabilities.

h: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
s: Researcher found over 100 serious vulnerabilities in UK government code, with one exposing 'god-tier' credentials.

h: The climate case for AI has not been made
s: Most industries haven't deployed AI in ways matching emissions-reduction projections despite corporate climate tech pledges.

h: Bikers and Bug-Lovers Join Forces to Fight a New Google Data Center
s: Wildlife groups, environmental nonprofits, and motorcycle enthusiasts unite to oppose Google's planned Thurrock data center.

s: World models that simulate physics in 3D space are being adopted by robotics and autonomous vehicle companies.

h: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
s: US approved Nvidia AI chip sales to Chinese firm with empty office and blacklisted ties.

h: AI debt concerns grow as ING reportedly seeks buyers for $500 million of data center loans
s: ING reportedly seeks buyers for $500 million portfolio of AI data center loans amid debt concerns.

h: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
s: China's intelligence agency reportedly recruited a tech executive to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for AI chip intelligence.

h: Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam
s: Approximately 100 protesters breached a Microsoft data center construction site in Amsterdam, scaling cranes and unfurling banners.

h: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
s: Democrats are calling for a national data center moratorium after midterm victories, citing voter opposition.

s: Potential Sciences raises tens of millions to train AI models on simulated chemistry data for faster drug discovery.

h: Researchers asked people to use AI chatbots for election info – results were mixed
s: Yale researchers found a third of users asked chatbots for election advice; chatbots varied widely in recommending candidates.

h: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says hackers used fake job interviews, AI tool to steal $6.3 billion in crypto
s: Hackers used fake job interviews and compromised AI tools to steal over $6 billion from Binance.
